maddeler.e:
ترويقت (form VI)
# تُرُويِقْتُ (turūyiqtu) /tu.ruː.jiq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# تُرُويِقْتَ (turūyiqta) /tu.ruː.jiq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# تُرُويِقْتِ (turūyiqti) /tu.ruː.jiq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# تُرُويِقَتْ (turūyiqat) /tu.ruː.ji.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
